m: लञ्चा f. a present, bribe, Nīlak.
1. लञ्ज् (cf. √ 2. लज्) cl. 1. P. लञ्जति, ‘to fry’ or ‘to blame’ (भर्त्सने v.l. भर्जने), Dhātup. vii, 65.
2. लञ्ज् (cf. √ लुञ्ज्) cl. 10. P. लञ्जयति, to be strong; to strike; to dwell; to give, Dhātup. xxxii, 30 (v.l.); to speak; to shine, xxxiii, 111; to manifest (also लञ्जापयति), xxxv, 66 (v.l.)
